slots.name: report length
slots.sentence: Tompkins County District Attorney Matthew Van Houten said charges were not filed because a six-page report provided by campus police to his office at the time did not include allegations that the woman was “drugged against her will or gang raped.”

slots.name: men expelled
slots.sentence: The school said two of the men were expelled, two were suspended for at least two semesters, one had already graduated before any punishment could be handed down, and two were found not to be responsible for sexual misconduct.
